tagline_en: Self-foaming deep-cleanse that purifies pores and soothes
tagline_zh: 自动起泡 · 毛孔深净 · 舒缓疗愈
overview_en: Natural actives purify pores, absorb excess oil and provide antibacterial, anti-inflammatory care; a self-foaming, oil-dissolving mask that gently melts pore build-up, calms redness, repairs the sensitive barrier and brightens dull, tired skin.
overview_zh: 蕴含天然活性成分，自动起泡深层净化毛孔、吸附多余油脂，温和溶解毛孔内堆积物；快速镇静泛红、改善炎症，修护敏感肌屏障，同时淡化暗沉与疲倦感，令肌肤细嫩透亮。
benefits_en: Preps skin so later steps absorb better
benefits_zh: 起泡深洁，净化毛孔垃圾
强韧屏障，防御敏感刺激
how_to_use_en: After deep-cleansing, follow with a soothing or hydrating mask.
how_to_use_zh: 深层净化后建议搭配舒缓或保湿型面膜使用
claims_flagged: 具净化毛孔、吸附油脂、抗菌消炎的功效
可针对毛囊初期角化症
淡化肌肤暗沉与疲倦感，肌肤由内而外焕发自然细嫩白皙
REVIEW: antibacterial / anti-inflammatory and follicular-keratosis (毛囊角化症) claims are therapeutic — admin to verify before publishing.
